scope: Conceptual integral water-cooled SMR; major component and procurement families, not a complete bill of materials.

parts.purpose: Supports plant loads and interfaces with the ground.
parts.limitation: Identify concrete, reinforcement and embed fabricators through the project EPC; Bechtel is not the material manufacturer.

parts.purpose: Provides structural support and radiation shielding.
parts.limitation: Geotechnical, structural and shielding design must define construction packages.

parts.purpose: Provides a leak-tight pool boundary.
parts.limitation: Confirm fabrication location, interfaces, inspection and installation scope.

parts.purpose: Provides controlled access through containment or other plant barriers.
parts.limitation: Access arrangement differs between a small steel module and a reactor building; select the correct boundary.

parts.purpose: Integrates the factory-manufactured reactor equipment.
parts.limitation: Public partnership establishes a supply relationship; obtain the exact work split and a current project offer.

parts.purpose: Contains the core and primary coolant pressure boundary.
parts.limitation: Capacity, materials, design interfaces and selected iPWR qualification remain unverified.

parts.purpose: Provides the starting material for major pressure-boundary parts.
parts.limitation: Confirm whether procurement is through the vessel manufacturer; avoid double-counting the vessel package.

parts.purpose: Closes the vessel and carries design-specific interfaces.
parts.limitation: Match head arrangement and penetrations to the selected OEM design.

parts.purpose: Supports and locates internal reactor assemblies and coolant flow paths.
parts.limitation: Requires proprietary drawings and design-authority approval.

parts.purpose: Transfers vessel loads into its support structure.
parts.limitation: Support geometry and structural qualification are design-specific.

parts.purpose: Transfers primary-loop heat to a separate steam circuit.
parts.limitation: General steam-generator capability is documented; integral/helical configuration is not established by this source.

parts.purpose: Provides the heat-transfer surface and separation between fluids.
parts.limitation: Confirm alloy, tube configuration, forming scope and interface with the steam-generator manufacturer.

parts.purpose: Moves the neutron-absorbing control assemblies.
parts.limitation: Exact in-vessel or external drive architecture and qualification remain open.

parts.purpose: Provides movable neutron absorption.
parts.limitation: Verify exact control-assembly manufacturing scope and compatibility with the fuel and drives.

parts.purpose: Holds the nuclear fuel in the selected reactor configuration.
parts.limitation: Fuel technology is proprietary; a supply relationship is not a reservation for this project.

parts.purpose: Provides the ceramic fuel inside the rods.
parts.limitation: Procure within the qualified fuel-supply route; raw-material and enrichment services are separate.

parts.purpose: Encapsulates pellets within the fuel assembly.
parts.limitation: Not an interchangeable catalog item; fuel design governs the product.

parts.purpose: Forms the first physical barrier around fuel material.
parts.limitation: Historical delivery evidence; exact alloy, facility and present capacity require confirmation.

parts.purpose: Maintains rod positioning and supports coolant flow.
parts.limitation: NuFUEL-HTP2 uses HTP spacer-grid technology; scope remains within the fuel manufacturer.

parts.purpose: Maintains primary-system pressure.
parts.limitation: An integral SMR may incorporate this function inside the vessel; a separate pressurizer may not be needed.

parts.purpose: Circulates primary coolant in pumped designs.
parts.limitation: Natural-circulation designs may omit this component entirely.

parts.purpose: Provides an additional containment boundary around the reactor vessel.
parts.limitation: Doosan documents module-equipment involvement, but this research does not establish the containment-vessel fabrication allocation.

parts.purpose: Provides design-specific shutdown cooling and safety functions.
parts.limitation: A generic heat exchanger, pool or valve does not establish a qualified integrated passive-safety system.

parts.purpose: Transfers decay heat through the selected cooling system.
parts.limitation: Documented component family; not proof of suitability for this concept's passive cooling arrangement.

parts.purpose: Converts steam energy into shaft rotation.
parts.limitation: Documented SMR portfolio and BWRX-300 project; match this iPWR steam cycle separately.

parts.purpose: Converts shaft rotation into electrical power.
parts.limitation: Select rating, cooling arrangement and electrical interfaces with the turbine package.

parts.purpose: Conditions steam between turbine stages where required.
parts.limitation: Not universal to every SMR turbine cycle.

parts.purpose: Condenses turbine exhaust steam back into water.
parts.limitation: Confirm condenser duty, cooling method and turbine exhaust interface.

parts.purpose: Recovers heat to preheat water returning to the steam generator.
parts.limitation: Number and arrangement depend on the chosen cycle; avoid assuming large-reactor equipment fits.

parts.purpose: Returns water to the steam generator at the required pressure.
parts.limitation: Obtain a pump selection for the actual duty and operating range.

parts.purpose: Supports cleanup of returning condensate.
parts.limitation: Tank manufacture does not cover resin selection, full process design or packaged-system integration.

parts.purpose: Moves water through the heat-rejection circuit.
parts.limitation: Normal-operation heat rejection must be distinguished from safety-related cooling duties.

parts.purpose: Rejects heat from the separate cooling-water loop to ambient air.
parts.limitation: General industrial capability only; size and temperature approach require site-specific selection.

parts.purpose: Rejects condenser heat using an evaporative cooling circuit.
parts.limitation: Water supply and site conditions determine applicability; this is not an additional mandatory component.

parts.purpose: Condenses turbine exhaust using air-cooled surfaces.
parts.limitation: Replaces the drawing's condenser-plus-water-loop arrangement rather than simply adding to it.

parts.purpose: Controls and isolates plant fluid paths.
parts.limitation: Select each valve by system duty and classification; not all valves share the same requirements.

parts.purpose: Performs assigned pressure-control or protective fluid functions.
parts.limitation: Exact safety/relief/isolation valve model and qualification must be evidenced individually.

parts.purpose: Drives selected valves electrically.
parts.limitation: Match valve torque, duty cycle, power source and environmental requirements.

parts.purpose: Joins and routes fluid lines.
parts.limitation: Material and code applicability depend on each line and its service.

parts.purpose: Combines pipe and fittings into installable sections.
parts.limitation: Identify the original material mill, fabrication scope and documentation chain.

parts.purpose: Carries piping loads while accommodating movement.
parts.limitation: Support loads and movements must come from the piping design.

parts.purpose: Restrains specified dynamic motion of piping or equipment.
parts.limitation: Confirm whether the design needs these devices and their approved duty.

parts.purpose: Provides mechanical fastening of equipment and structures.
parts.limitation: Each fastener family needs its own material, traceability and procurement requirements.

parts.purpose: Limits leakage at assigned mechanical interfaces.
parts.limitation: Select an exact product; a nuclear-sector marketing page is not specific qualification evidence.

parts.purpose: Transfers heat from auxiliary plant equipment.
parts.limitation: Actual cooling loads and safety classification are not yet specified.

parts.purpose: Stores or buffers fluids in supporting plant systems.
parts.limitation: Tank inventory and process requirements depend on the selected reactor architecture.

parts.purpose: Houses treatment media for water purification.
parts.limitation: This is the vessel supplier, not proof of a complete treatment-package supplier.

parts.purpose: Processes assigned protective signals and initiates protective actions.
parts.limitation: NuScale-related HIPS platform documented; plant implementation and current supply scope remain open.

parts.purpose: Coordinates normal plant monitoring and control.
parts.limitation: Separate normal controls from reactor protection; define each vendor's workshare.

parts.purpose: Measures neutron activity for reactor monitoring.
parts.limitation: Detector selection and its role in protection require the OEM instrumentation specification.

parts.purpose: Measures radiation in assigned plant areas and processes.
parts.limitation: Define each monitoring channel, sampling arrangement and qualification.

parts.purpose: Measures assigned plant pressures.
parts.limitation: 3153N is a capability example, not a selected part number.

parts.purpose: Measures assigned plant temperatures.
parts.limitation: Select sensor family and installation-specific qualification.

parts.purpose: Carries electrical power and instrument signals.
parts.limitation: Select cable family by location, duty and environmental qualification.

parts.purpose: Passes power and signals through a sealed containment boundary.
parts.limitation: Confirm the selected containment interface and qualified assembly.

parts.purpose: Connects generator output to the transmission voltage level.
parts.limitation: Electrical rating, grid interface, site and supply schedule remain unverified.

parts.purpose: Distributes, switches and protects plant electrical power.
parts.limitation: Announced partnership; verify specific product, manufacturer and qualification workshare.

parts.purpose: Supports designated DC loads when normal power is unavailable.
parts.limitation: PowerSafe GN documents nuclear capability; battery chemistry and duty are not selected.

parts.purpose: Supplies regulated DC power and maintains battery charge.
parts.limitation: BCS is a capability example; capacity and classification remain open.

parts.purpose: Provides assigned conditioned or uninterrupted electrical supply.
parts.limitation: Determine actual critical loads and required product configuration.

parts.purpose: Supports assigned backup AC power needs.
parts.role: Engine OEM / package scope to confirm
parts.limitation: Current source shows nuclear-sector customers; a current new-build emergency-generator package and safety role need confirmation.

parts.purpose: Controls airborne particulates in assigned ventilation systems.
parts.limitation: Filters/housings do not constitute a complete HVAC system; fans, dampers, ducts and chillers need separate sourcing.

parts.purpose: Produces and conditions water for assigned plant services.
parts.limitation: Obtain the package bill of materials and identify actual component manufacturers.

parts.purpose: Moves fuel using purpose-designed handling equipment.
parts.limitation: Design must match fuel and pool interfaces; not interchangeable with generic lifting equipment.

parts.purpose: Handles heavy plant components during installation and outages.
parts.limitation: Define load paths, handling duties and qualification through the project design.

parts.purpose: Supports fuel in the wet-storage configuration.
parts.limitation: Rack design must match the chosen fuel and storage authorization.

parts.purpose: Removes heat from the fuel-storage pool circuit.
parts.limitation: Heat exchanger capability is not a complete pool-cooling design.

parts.purpose: Provides a later-stage storage route for suitably prepared spent fuel.
parts.limitation: Do not assume existing casks accept the proposed SMR fuel without design and authorization review.

parts.purpose: Provides engineered packaging for defined fuel-storage or transport uses.
parts.limitation: Storage and transportation authorizations are distinct; verify exact contents and package design.

parts.purpose: Conditions and handles operational radioactive waste streams.
parts.limitation: Identify component OEMs and process scope; treatment services alone do not establish every equipment manufacturer.

sources.support: Explicit manufacture and delivery of reactor coolant pumps, control-rod drives and integrated vessel-head equipment.

sources.support: Documents manufacture of nuclear steam-generator tubing. Coil forming, alloy selection and exact geometry are separate qualification questions.

sources.support: Nuclear safety-related pipe supports, shock absorbers, constant hangers and spring hangers.

sources.title: B&G Manufacturing — Energy fasteners

sources.support: Nuclear power-electronics product family including inverters/UPS and chargers.

sources.support: Current page includes nuclear power plants among commercial customers; exact new-build emergency-generator offering is not established here.

sources.support: Design/build scope includes radwaste-processing systems, coded pressure vessels and remote handling equipment.

sources.support: Explicit in-house design/manufacture of fuel-handling systems and outage-critical cranes for nuclear plants and SMRs.
